name: Unidentified Mon Calamari cruiser
description: A cruiser class of Mon Calamari design was used as a trading vessel by the monarchy's Mon Cala Mercantile Fleet and was subsequently used by the naval forces of the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a warship during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. The Geist, the flagship of General Hera Syndulla, was of the class, as was Commander Lajaie's cruiser. The Star Cruisers had blunt wings and a bulbous surface.
